title: Read the checker's code first
statement: Read the checker's own code to learn exactly what it grades and parses, and match each item type's output structure to it, checked in code before producing at scale.
example: Training rows whose part labels were uppercase strings instead of the parser's lowercase nested parts dropped that item type from 90% to 16.7%.
detail: After training on 385 short-answer rows that used uppercase part labels with bare strings, where the expected structure has lowercase parts each nested with a question and a sample response, that type collapsed from 90% to 16.7% (`feedback_per_cell_schema_must_match_fewshot_bank_chain_canon.md`). The evaluation runner parses raw output once and counts a parse failure as a fail with no repair, so 262 rows of answer-format anchors gave 0/150 parsed (`project_eval_is_question_generation.md`). Reading the runner's code showed that it grades question objects, against a standing rule to train only answers.
against: The project held the opposite rule at the same time, that every training row should emit the answer rather than a question (`feedback_answer_format_only.md`, line 7). And sometimes the checker was what needed fixing: a strict parser failed 499 of 500 items that a model had wrapped in code fences, until it learned to strip them (`feedback_gemma4_wraps_json_in_markdown_fences_default_2026_06_02.md`, lines 9 and 13).

evidence.quote: **v81 SAQ collapsed -73.3pp (90% → 16.7%) after training on my Track B v2 corpus.** Root cause: 385/385 SAQ training rows used UPPERCASE A/B/C with bare-string parts, but the chain canon (fewshot_bank/by_cell/saq.jsonl) uses lowercase a/b/c with nested `{question, sample_response}` per part.
These are **question structures**. The model is graded on generating well-formed exam questions matching these schemas.
Line 88: `parse_json_response()` — single-attempt JSON parse on raw model output. Per the constraint block at lines 13-18, parse failure counts as a fail with no repair.
This is the v38 failure mode (262 rows of answer-format anchors → 0/150 parse_ok).
Every SFT/DPO row must train the model to **emit the answer**, not to generate questions about content.
2026-06-02 IB n=500 eval of v92 first-run failed 499/500 with `json_parse:JSONDecodeError`.
enhanced `_extract_json()` that strips fences + regex-extracts `{...}` blocks as fallback.
